name: Tamarind Hotel Danang beach Vietnam
description:
You might be eligible for a Genius discount at Tamarind Hotel Danang beach Vietnam. To check if a Genius discount is available for your selected dates sign in.


Genius discounts at this property are subject to book dates, stay dates and other available deals.

About this propertyTamarind Hotel Danang Beach: Tamarind Hotel Danang beach Vietnam is a 3-star hotel in Da Nang, a three-minute walk from My Khe Beach. It occupies 15 floors with 60 modern rooms, each overlooking either the beach or the city. Guests praise the location and service.

Rooftop and indoor pools: A rooftop pool on the upper levels offers city and sea views and sits in an open space; there is also an indoor swimming pool, plus a sun terrace and garden. A pool bar serves drinks beside the water.

Room features and comfort: Rooms are modern and include air conditioning, a private bathroom with shower and bidet, bathrobes and slippers, TV, minibar, refrigerator, electric kettle, work desk and seating area. Selected rooms include a balcony or kitchen facilities.

Dining and events: The on-site restaurant and bar serve Vietnamese and Western-Asian dishes and provide buffet service. Breakfast is an Asian buffet with local specialities, warm dishes, pastries, fruit and juice. The Pulpagrindo conference room can be arranged for events.

Practicalities and location: Free on-site private parking is available and bicycle parking is provided. The hotel is about 7 km from Da Nang International Airport and a short walk to My Khe Beach.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.3 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

name: Eden Ocean View Hotel Da Nang
description:
You might be eligible for a Genius discount at Eden Ocean View Hotel Da Nang. To check if a Genius discount is available for your selected dates sign in.


Genius discounts at this property are subject to book dates, stay dates and other available deals.

Located in Da Nang, opposite My Khe Beach, Eden Hotel Danang provides accommodation with a restaurant, free private parking, a fitness centre and a bar. Conveniently set in the Bac My An Beach district, this hotel features a shared lounge, as well as an indoor pool. The accommodation offers a 24-hour front desk, room service and currency exchange for guests.

The hotel offers a continental or buffet breakfast.

Eden Hotel Danang offers a terrace.

The accommodation also provides a business centre and guests can check the newspapers and use the fax machine and photocopier at Eden Hotel Danang.

Love Lock Bridge Da Nang is 3.6 km from the hotel, while Asia Park Danang is 3.9 km away. The nearest airport is Da Nang International, 5 km from Eden Hotel Danang, and the property offers a paid airport shuttle service.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.5 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap
